domain.reset: synchronous active-low; per-channel zero/ones/alternating/hash-derived general bit patterns; same logical value reset along its lifetime
domain.source_relations: kept combinational two-input XOR/permutation/inversion adapters over shared registered roots; every semantic state bit observed exactly once; adapter arithmetic excluded from owned state area
domain.relation_limit: synthetic affine two-root-bit relations only; arbitrary arithmetic source correlation still requires joint G qualification
domain.lifetime: contiguous native lifetime; include no-full-chain layouts; channels born after first cut and channels ending before last cut; valid always advances inside native bank
domain.known_bits: all dynamic, high/low zero padding, interior zero holes including 37-bit/36-variable and66-bit/64-variable layouts
service_protocols: one shared write enable including input-valid
independent data write enables with continuously advancing input-valid
domain.external_protocol: unconditional output data/valid capture from declared terminal native values; never gated by valid
domain.observation: post-state observer receives each service/native/external data and valid state exactly once; prevents unused-output pruning; observer area excluded

execution_definition.area_parameters: copy parent three-owner area_models exactly; no NNLS area refit
execution_definition.immutable_paths: copy all other six non-birth parent bounds at every exact clock; no calibration or reserve change
execution_definition.fitting_rows: 324 measured train/validation banks: old162 plus new162; same-source clocks/stages in one split; no consumed or fresh independent numeric labels
execution_definition.target: H_ps+delay_ps of each control path, per physical stage
execution_definition.baseline: global train maximum required control time plus original50ps, pooling only nine registered exact clocks
execution_definition.NNLS: unweighted train-only nonnegative least squares on protocol control_features; one is the declared constant feature; optional nine exact-clock indicators; no interpolation
execution_definition.upper_correction: max(0,max train required-regression_prediction), independent of validation and test
execution_definition.validation: all old/new rows covered for both mutable controls; original area20%/50% checked combined and each source cohort; unchanged six paths must cover all validation rows
execution_definition.selection: one complete two-control candidate per stage; passing validation first, mean predicted validation upper bound, compact serialized model bytes, declared order; no selectable model if none passes

query_contract.native_enable_and_valid: semantic control-load upper function, including train-only correction and original50ps
query_contract.comparison: each query uses its own conditional upper; do not compare a maximum required value to another sample upper
query_contract.source_scope: kept combinational two-input XOR/permutation/inversion adapters over shared registered roots; every semantic state bit observed exactly once; adapter arithmetic excluded from owned state area
